command:
set -euo pipefail
expected=2f9fa1004ab140eb312302f799bf2e6165c4aff6
actual=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
[[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || { echo HEAD_MISMATCH actual=$actual expected=$expected >&2; exit 71; }
state=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)
pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
[[ "$state" == inactive && "$pid" == 0 ]] || { echo VM_NOT_INACTIVE state=$state pid=$pid >&2; exit 72; }
[[ -f /var/lib/entityos/data/volatile-state-rescue/fred-20260913T0246p0700/MANIFEST.json ]] || { echo RESCUE_MANIFEST_MISSING >&2; exit 73; }
source_sha=$(sha256sum werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py | awk '{print $1}')
installed_sha=$(sudo -n sha256sum /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py | awk '{print $1}')
[[ "$source_sha" == "$installed_sha" ]] || { echo CUTOVER_TOOL_SHA_MISMATCH source=$source_sha installed=$installed_sha >&2; exit 74; }
echo PRE head=$actual state=$state pid=$pid source_sha=$source_sha
for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/welt.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db.vor-maerz-20260910; do sudo -n test -f "$p" || { echo SOURCE_MISSING=$p >&2; exit 75; }; done
sudo -n python3 /home/andreas/self-integration/werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py stage --execute
sudo -n python3 /home/andreas/self-integration/werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py verify
sudo -n python3 /home/andreas/self-integration/werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py condition
echo CONFIG_BINDS_BEGIN
sudo -n grep '^ENTITYOS_.*BINDS=' /etc/entityos/entityos.conf || true
echo CONFIG_BINDS_END
echo DURABLE_BEGIN
sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state -maxdepth 5 -type f -printf '%P %s bytes\n' | sort
echo DURABLE_END
echo SOURCE_POST_BEGIN
for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/welt.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db.vor-maerz-20260910; do if sudo -n test -f "$p"; then echo PRESERVED=$p; else echo SOURCE_LOST=$p >&2; exit 76; fi; done
echo SOURCE_POST_END
post_state=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)
post_pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
[[ "$post_state" == inactive && "$post_pid" == 0 ]] || { echo UNEXPECTED_RUNTIME_START state=$post_state pid=$post_pid >&2; exit 77; }
echo POST state=$post_state pid=$post_pid CUTOVER_VERIFIED=1 NO_START=1 NO_RESTART=1
